input.sql:
SELECT b.region,
       ROUND(SUM(d.revenue), 2) AS ciro_tl,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.branch_id) AS satis_yapan_sube_sayisi,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM branches b2 WHERE b2.region = b.region) AS toplam_sube_sayisi
FROM daily_branch_sales d
JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = d.branch_id
WHERE d.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND d.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY b.region
ORDER BY ciro_tl DESC

input.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(d.revenue), 2) AS toplam_ciro,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.branch_id IS NULL THEN d.revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS eslesmeyen_ciro,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.branch_id) AS sube_sayisi
FROM daily_branch_sales d
LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = d.branch_id
WHERE d.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND d.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
